elsewhere.title: Tenshu is open in another tab
elsewhere.body: Tenshu runs in one tab at a time, so your data can't get out of step. Use it here to move it to this tab.
elsewhere.waiting: Waiting for the other tab to finish saving. This can take up to two minutes.

error.gone: This link has been revoked or has expired.
error.decrypt: This share couldn't be decrypted. The link may be incomplete, mistyped or corrupted.
error.meta: This share is missing its file details, so it can't be opened. Ask the sender for a new link.
error.noKey: This link is missing its decryption key. Make sure you copied the full URL.
error.network: Couldn't reach the share. Check your connection and try again.
